messages:
alex k.: weird nondeterminism in eval-runner with top_p sampling even when seed set to 42. small model bring-up shows outputs vary across runs. anyone seen top_p sensitivity when using quantized kernels? :thinking:

priya r.: hmm can you paste the runner command + config? also which model and quant backend?

alex k.: command: `./eval-runner --suite convai --model ./builds/opt-ggml-q4_0.bin --seed 42 --batch-size 4 --top_p 0.92 --temperature 0.0`
Log snippet:
```
[run 0] seed=42 sampler=top_p top_p=0.92 temp=0.0 output=... (A)
[run 1] seed=42 sampler=top_p top_p=0.92 temp=0.0 output=... (B)
```
Outputs A/B differ by a token mid-sequence.

matt g.: could be per-worker RNG streams or kernel reorder. We had a bug where worker pool reused RNG without adding worker id to stream. quick check: is `seed` passed to all workers or only master? :bug:

alex k.: config shows `seed: 42` at root, but worker args get `--worker-seed 0` from CLI. looks like worker-seed defaulting. repro: runs with `--workers 4` diverge, `--workers 1` stable.

sophia l.: that explains it. Two mitigations: 1) deterministic seeding per worker (seed + worker_idx * CONST) 2) deterministic sampler that doesn't rely on FP thresholds across vectorized ops. quantization amplifies small FP differences so top_p cutoff moves.

jordan t.: another trick: set temperature very small (1e-6) instead of 0.0 and use top_k=40 to reduce sensitivity.

alex k.: patch idea: when batching, compute sample RNG as `pcg32(seed ^ siphash(worker_idx, sample_idx))` and force single-threaded sampling for top_p when `--deterministic-sampling` enabled. putting a fallback in CI to detect nondet runs.

matt g.: can you open a minimal unit test in eval-runner that runs the same prompts across workers and asserts token-level equality? then CI can run it with q4 kernels. I'll add an annotation for flaky tests to auto-retry 3x.

ci-bot: flaky-test-detected: eval-nondet-sampler. rerunning job (attempt 2 of 3)

sophia l.: FYI quant kernel profiling: small fp differences happen in mmx path due to loop unrolling. I can add an option `--force-fp32-accum` to compare. might be slower but useful for debugging.

alex k.: thanks. I'll open PR with deterministic seeding + unit test + `--deterministic-sampling` flag. assigning to @matt @sophia for review. :thumbsup:

priya r.: also let's add a dashboard metric in console: "eval-runner-repro-rate" that tracks per-commit pass/fail for the token-equality test. helps catch regressions early.

matt g.: +1. will wire a lightweight eval job on PRs to run that test with 3 quant backends.

jordan t.: Also add note to onboarding doc: "quantized models can change sampling behavior; prefer top_k for deterministic CI" :memo:

alex k.: filing issue: https://redwood-inc.atlassian.com/browse/ENGML-1029
